authority: ADR 0050 — the frozen behavioral population is a snapshot at selection_boundary_commit and binds as a subset floor of the live retained set, not as an equality. A frozen row that is no longer retained is a failure; a retained key above the floor was never qualified and is declared here as owed debt.
rule: Every key in doctrine/chain_currency/retained_bundles.json that is absent from doctrine/production_genericity/behavioral_population.tsv must appear below, naming the held-out relations it owes and the leaf that owes them. Declaration admits nothing into the qualified population; it records what the key still owes and who owes it. An undeclared key above the floor is a gate failure.
lives_here_because: This list GROWS with retention, and behavioral_qualification.json is frozen release evidence whose digest is pinned by 35 executed held-out attempts. Keeping a moving set out of a frozen artifact is the same separation ADR 0050 requires of the population itself; declaring it here costs zero re-pins.
